channel.title: Fire Engineering Magazine - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Fire Engineering Magazine (fireengineering.com)

item.title: Two Taken to Burn Center After Explosion at NJ Cocoa Butter Processing Plant
item.description: A factory explosion in Logan Township injured multiple victims, with two transferred to a burn center.

item.title: 80,000 Baby Monitors Recalled Due to Overheating Issues, Fire Hazard
item.description: Hisense has recalled about 81,000 Babysense Max View Baby Monitors due to potential overheating and fire hazards.

item.title: E-Bike Starts Fire at Yale University’s CT Robotics Lab
item.description: An e-bike fire in a Yale University robotics lab caused smoke and damage to nearby equipment.

item.title: Miami-Dade Firefighters Battle Five-Alarm Warehouse Fire
item.description: Over 200 firefighters battled a five-alarm fire at a warehouse near Miami Gardens with hazardous materials inside. The fire may burn for days.

item.title: Fire Rages at Historic AL Nightclub That Closed After Multiple Homicides
item.description: A fire occurred at The Quest, a former Birmingham nightclub that served the LGBTQ+ community, which closed in 2024 after repeated violence and a double homicide.

item.title: CA Hazmat Explosion Leads to Investigation, Arrest
item.description: An executive was arrested for illegal storage and disposal of hazardous materials linked to a chemical explosion at a Riverbank waste facility that injured a worker.

item.title: Credentialing, Certification, and Valued Training
item.description: Demond Simmons on the importance of training, with a specific look at credentialing and certification in this excerpt from the NVFC's "Training Volunteers to Be Combat Ready."

item.title: What You Need to Know About Truck Work and Tower Tactics
item.description: Mike Scotto, lieutenant (ret.), FDNY, joins host Dave McGlynn for a discussion about truck company and tower ladder operations for this episode of The Training Officer. Scotto addresses apparatus positioning, tower-bucket tactics, victim removal into the bucket, search techniques from outside venting, and more. item.title: MA Firefighters Knock Down Condo Fire; No Injuries Reported
item.description: Residents displaced by a condominium fire in Holyoke are receiving assistance from the American Red Cross. The cause of the fire is under investigation, with no reported injuries.

item.title: Man Killed in NH Mobile Home Fire
item.description: A fire at a mobile home in Madbury late Thursday night resulted in one man's death. The cause is under investigation, but it is not currently deemed suspicious, officials said.
